projects.title: Kloud
projects.pitch: Self-hosted AI platform with per-user quotas.
projects.problem: Centralise and control access to AI (Claude) for the family, with per-user quotas, without depending on individual paid accounts for everyone.
projects.architecture: Web platform: Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, JWT authentication, Claude API integration.
projects.result: Functional self-hosted platform, fine-grained per-user quota management, architecture reusable for other AI use cases.

projects.title: WDS Track
projects.problem: Track Würth (WDS) sales reps' field visits in a simple, traceable way, without a heavy tool imposed by IT.
projects.architecture: Web app generating and scanning QR codes to check in visits, with a lightweight database.
projects.result: Tool deployed and used internally, designed and maintained autonomously outside the standard IT pipeline — proof of an ability to ship fast within a constrained large-group context.

projects.title: WDS Copilote
projects.pitch: WhatsApp chatbot for the WDS team.
projects.problem: Provide a conversational contact point (WhatsApp) for the WDS team's everyday needs, without a dedicated frontend.
projects.architecture: WhatsApp Business chatbot connected to a backend API.
projects.result: Working proof of concept of a professional conversational channel, foundation for a future AI customer chatbot (under RSSI/IT validation with the Claude API).

projects.title: Blind Map
projects.pitch: Indoor voice navigation for visually impaired people.
projects.problem: Help visually impaired people move around indoors (public buildings, etc.) where classic GPS doesn't work.
projects.architecture: Mobile app for indoor voice navigation.
stack: to be completed as the project progresses
projects.result: Project carried under the French National Student-Entrepreneur Status (SNEE), 2026-2027 application via Pépite Etena — high social-impact project, in entrepreneurial structuring phase.

projects.title: Eteint Play
projects.problem: Create a unifying, well-organised event for the student community.
projects.architecture: Student association organising football tournaments in the ELT format, with several editions held.
projects.result: Proof of project-management, organisation and leadership skills, outside a purely technical context — a good human counterpoint to the rest of the portfolio.
